memory_candidates.content: When editing an agent-system source store from inside a consumer-repo implement dispatch, the source-store repo is often ALSO a deploy consumer of itself (self-hosting/dogfooding). A plan's own redeploy phase may target only the external consumer repo, leaving the source-store repo's OWN self-hosted .claude/ tree stale relative to the just-edited source files. If a phase's verification criterion runs verify-deploy.sh (or check-extension-docs.sh) against the source-store repo itself, that stale self-deploy can surface a 'deployed script content drift' or stale index-entries.json line_count FAIL unrelated to the actual edit. Fix: run deploy-headless.sh (default, non-destructive) against the source-store repo itself, and generate-context-line-counts.sh --write, after editing any file whose line count or content it tracks.

A verify-deploy.sh test fixture that is git-init'd but never git-add's/commits its rsync-copied content will silently fail any gate whose enumeration mechanism depends on `git ls-files` (e.g. lint-shellcheck.sh's default *.sh discovery), because git ls-files on a fresh, nothing-staged repo returns empty, causing a 'no files found to scan' environment error that verify-deploy.sh reports as a generic FAIL. This masquerades as an unrelated or flaky test failure. Diagnose by re-invoking the specific failing gate's underlying script directly against a copy of the fixture with REPO_ROOT explicitly set to the fixture path, and check whether its enumeration mechanism is git-based.

When a shared source-store repo has heavy concurrent multi-session activity (many other tasks' uncommitted work live at once), and a verification command shows an unexpected FAIL unrelated to the file(s) you edited, isolate causation via git stash: stash only your own edited file(s), re-run the exact same check, and compare. An identical failure before and after your edit proves the failure is pre-existing/foreign, not a regression you introduced -- avoids wasted effort chasing a cause that isn't yours, and provides concrete evidence for the deviation record instead of a hand-wave.
